description: The NormalizedIter Iterator impl uses a pending_space bool as a deferred-emit flag. The control flow has two entry points per next() call: the pending_space branch (skip remaining spaces, fall through) and the main branch. The 'fall through' comment on line 666 is necessary because the code after the if block handles both cases. A reader unfamiliar with this pattern must trace through both paths to verify correctness. Alternative: represent the iterator state with an explicit enum (Scanning, PendingSpace) or restructure as a flat state machine with a single code path. The existing regression tests are thorough, so this is style-only.
title: NormalizedIter pending_space state machine requires careful reading
